title: Disney Beauty & the Beast 1992 VHS Black Diamond Classic Edition (see pics)
descriptionText:
See pics. Writing on VHS tape.

Experience the magic of Disney's classic tale with this VHS tape of Beauty and the Beast. This diamond edition collector's item features an NTSC signal standard and a G rating, making it perfect for all ages. The tape is in the English language and was released in 1992 by Walt Disney Gold Classic Collection. 

The VHS tape comes in a black diamond classic edition, as shown in the pictures. It is not a former rental and is ideal for fans of fairy tales and animation and anime genres. This Disney Beauty & the Beast VHS tape is a must-have for any collector and is a rare find. Add it to your collection today!
